# test file and test call identification

A source file is considered a test file if its filename contains '.test.' or '.spec.'; test cases are identified by calls named exactly 'test' or 'it' (regex ^(test|it)$) with a string first argument, and such cases are emitted as 'test_case_observed' facts using framework 'jest'.

Detect test modules and test cases so test-related facts (test_target_observed, test_case_observed) can be emitted.
